note: Topic rules are applied to OFFICIAL series metadata from GET /series (ticker, category, tags). Rules are checked in order; the first matching topic wins. Changing a rule changes which markets appear, so every change must be logged in COORDINATION.md.

topics.label: Gas prices
topics.description: AAA-based US gasoline price series (state and national). Excludes natural gas, EIA inventories, and ethanol.

topics.label: Golf
topics.description: Series whose official tags include 'Golf' (PGA Tour, LIV, DP World Tour, LPGA, Ryder Cup, and related).

topics.label: Crypto
topics.description: Series in the official 'Crypto' category (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and others).

topics.label: Culture
topics.description: Series in the official 'Entertainment' or 'Culture' category (music, film, TV, awards, media rankings).

topics.label: Elections
topics.description: Series in the official 'Elections' category (national, state and local races, party nominations).

excluded_note: Series in 'Test' or 'harrison-test' categories are never matched because no rule names them.
